findings.message:
[P1] Refresh the uos.css content hash in its import URL

The added declarations change `public/uos.css`, but `public/styles.css:5` still imports `/uos.css?v=87fcef4a45f634a8`, the content hash of the old bytes. The immutable cache policy in `main.ts:9111-9113` keeps that old response for one year for returning browsers, so they never receive these explicit-theme filters. Update the import token to the new content hash `764344de04e85371` (or otherwise invalidate the URL).

public/uos.css:73-74

summary: Explicit theme filters and the four-combination regression are implemented, but the changed uos.css URL was not re-versioned, so returning clients can retain the stale immutable stylesheet.

evidence: `public/uos.css` lines 73-74 set the dark explicit-theme logo and credit filters; lines 93-94 set the light values.
The system-preference media query remains the fallback in `public/styles.css`, and `tests/theme-icon-filters.test.ts` covers both fallbacks and both explicit themes.
